app.run:
The app is Funkuino Studio, a localhost web app (aiohttp server + vanilla-JS frontend). Never run it against the owner's real library (~/Music/Funkuino) or the real ESPuino box: a click on Sync would write to a device a child may be listening to. Instead start it against a throwaway library, without a device, from the workspace root (needs the setup's .venv). The block below is for both start and restart: it stops a server left from an earlier run (waiting at most 5 s for it to exit), keeps the library, port and URL of the first run, and waits at most 20 s until the new server answers. Run it as one command, and run it again after every Python change:

```
D=/tmp/funkuino-obeya-$(basename "$PWD"); mkdir -p "$D/config"
if [ -f "$D/studio.pid" ]; then P=$(cat "$D/studio.pid"); kill "$P" 2>/dev/null; for i in $(seq 1 25); do kill -0 "$P" 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.2; done; fi
[ -d "$D/library" ] || .venv/bin/python -c 'import sys; from pathlib import Path; sys.path.insert(0, "dev"); import shot; shot.seed_library(Path(sys.argv[1]))' "$D/library"
[ -f "$D/port" ] || .venv/bin/python -c 'import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.bind(("127.0.0.1",0)); print(s.getsockname()[1])' > "$D/port"
[ -f "$D/config/credentials.env" ] || echo 'SDK_TOKEN=sk-ant-oat01-demo-not-a-real-token' > "$D/config/credentials.env"
PORT=$(cat "$D/port")
FUNKUINO_CONFIG_DIR="$D/config" FUNKUINO_DATA_DIR="$D/library" PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 nohup bin/funkuino studio --no-browser --port "$PORT" --host funkuino-demo.invalid > "$D/studio.log" 2>&1 &
echo $! > "$D/studio.pid"; echo "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" > "$D/url"
for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -sf "$(cat "$D/url")" >/dev/null && { echo "up: $(cat "$D/url")"; break; }; kill -0 "$(cat "$D/studio.pid")" 2>/dev/null || { echo "Studio died:"; tail -20 "$D/studio.log"; break; }; sleep 0.5; done
```

Go on only once it printed `up:`. The address is always the one in `$D/url`; take every browser or demo URL from there, never type a port by hand. The server log is in `$D/studio.log`. If it says the port is in use, a stray Studio from an earlier start still holds it: `lsof -nP -iTCP:$(cat "$D/port") -sTCP:LISTEN` names its PID; kill that and run the block again. Do not write your own wait loops with an open-ended `sleep`: the hook blocks them; every wait needs a fixed upper bound like the loops above.

The seed (dev/shot.py's `seed_library`) makes one song, one Hörspiel and one album with covers, so the Bibliothek tab has rows to show; put more files under `$D/library/files/` and `$D/library/card-covers/` (naming conventions in CLAUDE.md) to show other states. There is no login. The device is unreachable on purpose, so Studio shows the box as offline and Sync/RFID cannot touch hardware. The dummy `SDK_TOKEN` in `$D/config/credentials.env` makes the Agent tab show its composer (for testing typed text, layout, reloads); it is not a real token, so never submit a message there. If a change can only be shown with the real box or a working agent, ask the owner first. After a change to the frontend (scripts/studio_web/) reload the page; after a Python change run the block again. For a quick look without a browser, `.venv/bin/python dev/shot.py [bibliothek|agent|sync|karten]` writes screenshots to dev/shots/. Stop the server afterwards: `kill $(cat "$D/studio.pid")`.
app.stop: D=/tmp/funkuino-obeya-$(basename "$PWD"); if [ -f "$D/studio.pid" ]; then kill "$(cat "$D/studio.pid")" 2>/dev/null; rm -f "$D/studio.pid"; fi; true
